subject.title: Tool outputs sometimes render as image attachments and become unreadable to the agent

question: Should maintainers make PR #99524's fresh-output-priority prompt projection behavior the canonical next fix for #99241, or wait for broader provider/media sanitizer work before closing this issue?
rationale: The remaining fix path changes which tool-result text survives saturated aggregate recovery and overlaps with separate provider/media sanitizer work, so maintainer intent is needed before declaring one path canonical.

options.title: Review and prove #99524 first
options.body: Treat #99524 as the next canonical fix candidate, require live saturated-session proof, and keep #99241 open until that proof and any provider sanitizer follow-up are resolved.

options.title: Wait for provider sanitizer work
options.body: Hold #99241 until #100795 or equivalent provider/media sanitizer work lands and then retest whether prompt-projection changes are still needed.

options.title: Split the issue into narrower canonicals
options.body: Keep #99241 as the umbrella and explicitly route prompt-projection, provider media, and UI/channel symptoms to separate closing criteria.

recommendation.title: Review and prove #99524 first
recommendation.body: Treat #99524 as the next canonical fix candidate, require live saturated-session proof, and keep #99241 open until that proof and any provider sanitizer follow-up are resolved.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged #98955 work owns the current central truncation/protection helper that #99524 extends.
